## Checklist

- [ ] Based on `develop`, targeting `develop`
- [ ] The title starts with a Conventional Commit prefix (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`...): it categorizes the release notes
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, `mypy app` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs updated (README / wiki) when behaviour or settings change
- [ ] No secrets, personal IPs or photos committed
